title: TextEDA IR v0.7 — procurement shard
description: Which parts a board is bought with. The primary shard is normative (the build is made of these parts); the alternatives shard is advisory (a second source does not change the build). See spec/procurement.md and ADR-0030.

format.description: Language version of the .teda file that produced this shard; see teda.md §13.

source.description: Source-file location: path relative to the project root plus an optional line number.

procurement.description: The selections of one board: which part is bought for which generic line.

board.description: The board these selections belong to. A selection always belongs to a board, because a BOM is a board's (ADR-0002).

role.description: Which of the two files this is: the primary selections (normative) or the second sources (advisory).

selections.description: One row per selected BOM line, ordered by the line key.

selection.description: One selected BOM line: a generic and its requirement on the left, the part that is bought on the right. A line that needs nothing bought carries `not_required` instead of a part.

generic.description: The generic device this line buys. The left side of the row is the BOM line key: a generic id plus the values of its declared parameters.

params.description: The requirement the part has to satisfy, in the generic's declared parameter order; optional columns may be omitted.

part.description: The part that is bought for this line.

not_required.description: The line needs nothing bought: there is nothing to order for it. The row says `-> not-required`.

line.description: Starting line of the selection in the source file, for diagnostic locations.
